svg.text: Chance a company became a top-20 contributor, if its rank on the last close before the year was at or above p
x = rank inside that year's pool (0 = weakest, 99 = strongest) · flat line = the trait tells you nothing · segments green where the chance rises, red where it falls
solid = relative strength rank (all) · everyone: 14.7% · strongest ranks: 36.8%
long dashes = relative strength rank (comparable size) · everyone: 23.6% · strongest ranks: 51.9%
dots = revenue-growth rank (comparable size) · everyone: 23.6% · strongest ranks: 34.8%
